name: Xpel Tea Tree Essential Oil 10ml
description:
Xpel Tea Tree Essential Oil 10ml

Harness the natural power of Xpel Tea Tree Essential Oil, a 100% pure oil designed for skin care, hair care, and holistic wellness.

Key Benefits:

Antifungal & Antibacterial: Helps protect against infections and promotes a healthy scalp and skin.

Anti-Viral & Anti-Inflammatory: Supports skin healing and reduces inflammation.

Gentle & Safe: Kind to your skin, suitable for topical use when diluted.

Pure & Natural: 100% pure tea tree oil for maximum effectiveness.

Volume: 10ml | Brand: Xpel | Developed in UK, Manufactured in PRC, Imported from UK

Perfect for skin, hair, and wellness applications, providing natural protection and care.
